title: decentralized multi-agent multi-armed bandits for smart electric vehicles charging
core_idea: Propose a fully decentralized, fair multi-agent approach (d-mab2ab-ts) that models each EV charging decision at each instant as a two-armed bandit (charge or not) and uses Thompson sampling to select arms while accounting for uncertainty in other agents' choices; the method is model-free and has computational complexity linear in the number of arms.
tldr: A decentralized, model-free multi-agent two-armed bandit method using Thompson sampling to coordinate EV charge/no-charge decisions under uncertainty, aiming to avoid grid congestion, lower consumer costs, and preserve scalability and privacy.
